overview.description: The Direxion Daily Gold Bull 2X ETF (UGLD) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the LBMA Gold Price index. The fund seeks daily investment results, before fees and expenses, of 200% of the price performance of the gold. UGLD was launched on May 27, 2026 and is issued by Direxion.
